title: Homes for Adults with Intellectual Disabilities
what_it_is: Homes for Adults with Intellectual Disabilities

sections.label: Adult Disability Homes and respite care
sections.summary: Six Adult Disability Homes provide 650 places, with average waits of six to 12 months and urgent waits under a month.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: They also provide short-term respite care for caregivers.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: There are six Adult Disability Homes providing 650 places for adults with intellectual disability.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Over the past three years, the average waiting time between referral to enrolment into Homes ranged between six and 12 months.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For those requiring urgent admission, the typical waiting time is less than a month.

sections.label: New Sembawang Walk Adult Disability Home
sections.summary: A new Adult Disability Home at Sembawang Walk will provide 180 places by end-2017.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For example, by end-2017 there will be a new Adult Disability Home located at Sembawang Walk with a provision of 180 places.

sections.label: Increasing places and reviewing services
sections.summary: Places are planned to increase to 1,600 by 2018, and the continuum of services is being reviewed.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Overall, we are planning to increase the number of places to 1,600 by 2018.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We are also reviewing the continuum of services to our clients and caregivers so that we can care for these people with better facilities and services.
